descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Accenture Advanced Technology Center is looking for Cloud Data Engineers who are ready for a challenging IT career focused on Data Platform Modernization and the development of cloud-based data and analytics solutions for business.
You will have the opportunity to grow as a Data Engineer and develop toward a Data Architect role under Accenture’s guidance. You will help our clients build applications and modern data platforms with a cloud-first, data-focused mindset, using Databricks to create the next generation of innovative solutions for leading organizations across different industries.
You will be part of our state-of-the-art Accenture Data Hub and join a growing community of Cloud and Data Engineering professionals. Members have opportunities to receive dedicated training and pursue Databricks and cloud certifications. We provide learning materials, bootcamps and certification support to help you develop your technical expertise and advance your career.
 Must-have Skills
 What Will Help You Succeed
Hands-on experience with Databricks
Strong knowledge of Python, PySpark and SQL
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines
Experience with cloud data services in Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform
Good understanding of Apache Spark and distributed data processing
Experience with Delta Lake and Delta Tables
Knowledge of relational and non-relational data concepts
Experience with data modelling and data warehouse concepts
Experience with Git-based development and CI/CD processes
Good communication skills and English proficiency
Nice-to-have skills
Databricks Workflows, Jobs and Pipelines
Unity Catalog, access management and data lineage
Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Google Cloud Dataflow, Talend or Informatica
Cloud storage such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage
Medallion architecture using Bronze, Silver and Gold layers
Structured Streaming or Kafka
REST APIs and data integration patterns
Data quality, monitoring and observability
Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code technologies
Databricks or cloud provider certification
 Your Responsibilities
Design, develop, test and maintain scalable cloud data pipelines
Build ingestion and transformation solutions using Databricks, Python, PySpark and SQL
Develop and manage Delta Lake tables and lakehouse structures
Implement batch and streaming data processing solutions
Integrate data from databases, APIs, files, applications and cloud services
Design and maintain reliable ETL/ELT workflows
Apply data modelling principles for analytics and reporting
Implement data quality checks, validation rules and monitoring
Optimize Spark and Databricks workloads for performance and cost
Apply Git and CI/CD practices for testing and deployment
Create technical documentation and automated tests
Troubleshoot pipeline failures and production issues
Collaborate with architects, analysts, data scientists and client teams
Translate requirements into scalable data solutions
Contribute to Agile delivery and knowledge sharing
 What We Offer
Exposure to complex cloud and data platform modernization projects
Structured learning paths, technical training and certification support
Career development toward senior engineering and architecture roles
Collaboration with experienced and highly skilled data professionals
A positive, inclusive and multicultural working environment
A flexible benefits package aligned with the company’s local policies
Opportunities to work with Databricks and modern cloud data technologies
 Employee Benefits – Be Well, Work Well, Live Well
Access to multiple online learning platforms
Access to various training programs from soft skills areas
Work from home
Continuous growth in a positive and multicultural work environment
Refer-a-Friend – get a bonus in the employee referral program
Family oriented benefits
Share purchase plan
Personalized benefits package, including meal vouchers, public transportation, medical services, private pension, life insurance, gym subscription and many more
 The position is available exclusively for collaboration under an individual working contract (CIM).
